note.en: Gives a large amount of CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG with no conditions, plus up to 40% extra Ice DMG while teammates keep applying Anomalies. No other Anomaly W-Engine has the CRIT stats she scales with.

Grace's signature and a strong all-round Anomaly choice. Special and EX Special Attacks each add stacks. About 20 to 25% behind [[wengine:hailstorm-shrine]], and it makes reaching 100% CRIT Rate harder.
Battle Pass W-Engine. It can be very strong or fairly weak depending on the team, and only suits teams that apply an Anomaly before the wearer does or keep one up at all times.
Craftable. Gives 75 Anomaly Proficiency with no conditions and a stackable ATK% buff, which suits agents that spend Energy quickly through EX Special Attacks.
Craftable. Gives 25% ATK% with no conditions and stacking Anomaly Proficiency. It works best when your team keeps Anomalies up continuously.
